title: Let the deeper fear swallow the lesser ones
summary: This meets the heart scattered by a hundred small fears. The line says the one who tastes Naam forgets the lesser fears that used to organize the day.
takeaway: Let reverence undo the smaller fears.
lifeApplication: Before the next anxiety spiral, speak the line slowly enough for the body to hear it. Let reverence take up more room than the petty fears do.

source.shortMeaning: Deeper reverence makes the smaller fears fall quietly away.
source.lifeApplication: When fear multiplies, stay with the line until the smaller ones begin to thin.

evidence.coreClaim: Deeper reverence makes the smaller fears fall quietly away.
